description: We take raw, unrefined streams from the cosmos and translate them into human-sized answers. Armed with caffeine, open-source satellite feeds, and zero patience for orbital decay, we turn big data into bigger ideas.Those who have a vision are always welcomed.
summary: FORGOTTEN ON THE MOON is an interactive educational website developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. The project aims to bring attention to the equipment and scientific instruments left behind during space exploration missions and help people understand their historical and scientific importance. The website features six interactive equipment icons representing Apollo 11, Apollo 15, Viking 1, Spirit & Opportunity, Surveyor and Kepler. Visitors can click on each icon to explore dedicated sections containing information about the equipment, its mission and its contributions to space exploration. The platform also includes COSMO, an AI-powered assistant that guides visitors, answers questions about space missions and explains complex concepts in simple language. To make learning more engaging, the website features an interactive quiz  project are sourced exclusively from NASA's official website. The website was developed with the help of Google Antigravity for AI-assisted development and coding, Lovable for website creation and design, and GitHub for version control, project management and team collaboration. Overall, FORGOTTEN ON THE MOON combines space history, interactive storytelling and AI-assisted technology to make lunar and planetary exploration more accessible, interesting and memorable, while celebrating the scientific achievements of equipment that is often forgotten. Its central message is: "Some missions end. Their stories remain."

Infinite Orbit – An Interactive NASA Space Exploration and Learning Platform

Infinite Orbit is an interactive educational platform designed to make space exploration and NASA's achievements more engaging, accessible, and enjoyable. It allows users to explore the history of six important NASA missions through interactive stories, mission archives, educational quizzes, and an exciting space exploration game.

The platform includes a four-level Space Relic Expedition game in which players explore simulated planetary environments, including the Moon and Mars. Players must overcome obstacles such as lunar craters, dust storms, canyons, and boulder fields while experiencing different gravity conditions. By reaching mission artifacts, users can unlock information about historic NASA spacecraft and discoveries.

The website also features an interactive quiz to test users' knowledge, a space assistant named Cosmo to answer questions about NASA missions and space science, and links to NASA's official resources, including NASA Image Library, NASA Open APIs, and NASA Open Data.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Our project makes space science and astronomy easier to understand, especially for students and young learners. It encourages curiosity, scientific thinking, interactive learning, and interest in space exploration. Instead of simply reading about space missions, users can actively participate in a learning experience.

Creativity and Innovation

The main creative aspect of Infinite Orbit is the combination of historical storytelling, educational content, gamification, and an interactive space assistant in one platform. It transforms NASA's mission history into an engaging digital experience and helps users understand the importance of past space missions and their discoveries.

Development Approach and Tools

The project is developed as a web-based platform and hosted using GitHub Pages. It brings together interactive website features, game mechanics, educational content, and NASA-related resources. The platform is designed to be accessible through a web browser on different devices.

Factors Considered

During development, we considered user accessibility, educational value, ease of navigation, engagement, scientific relevance, and the importance of connecting users with authentic NASA information. Our goal is to make learning about space exploration both informative and enjoyable.

Infinite Orbit represents our vision of connecting space history with interactive technology and inspiring the next generation of space explorers.
